title.zh: 【美财政部撤回针对非托管钱包和 CVC 加密混币的拟议加密货币监控规则】
title.en: 【美财政部撤回针对非托管钱包和 CVC 加密混币的拟议加密货币监控规则】

current_state.zh: The U.S. Treasury is withdrawing FinCEN's long-pending proposed rules targeting non-custodial wallets and crypto mixing, which would have required financial institutions to collect counterparty information for transactions above $3,000 and report those above $10,000.
current_state.en: The U.S. Treasury is withdrawing FinCEN's long-pending proposed rules targeting non-custodial wallets and crypto mixing, which would have required financial institutions to collect counterparty information for transactions above $3,000 and report those above $10,000.
